name: eco
description: Atalhos para os dois apps. Sem dependências: cada app gerencia as suas.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web ci && uv --directory apps/api sync
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory apps/api run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:web: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run format:check
scripts.lint:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff check && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
